title: Align Zephyr SCHC fragmentation constants with canonical 179-byte profile
description: The canonical format-v2 SCHC vectors and spec require TILE_SIZE=179 and a 126-tile ceiling of 22,554 bytes, but lichen/subsys/schc/include/schc/schc.h currently defines SCHC_FRAGMENT_TILE_SIZE=187 and SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE=23,562. Reconcile implementation, buffer sizing, fragmentation/reassembly semantics, and tests with the canonical profile. Acceptance: cross-implementation v2 vectors pass at 1,281/22,554/22,555 boundaries under host and pinned Zephyr.
notes: Reconciled public fragmentation profile constants: TILE_SIZE=179, MAX_PACKET_SIZE derived as 126*179=22,554, MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE derived as tile+6=185. Added focused capacity assertion that the canonical 22,555-byte rejection leaves fragmenter state byte-for-byte unchanged. Host AppleClang C2x -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic ASan/UBSan bounds harness passed: compile-time 179/126/22,554/185 checks, 22,555 returns SCHC_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL atomically, 22,554 initializes to 126 fragments, and 1,281 initializes to 8. Generator 12/12 tests, ruff, bitstream strict compile, and git diff --check pass. Pinned runtime not run: approved workstation was already running under another agent ownership; per orchestrator instruction it was neither accessed nor stopped. Claim released pending pinned schc_generic runtime; once this passes, project-LICHEN-worker6-7dyd should be unblocked.
close_reason: Host-side verified locally: schc.h constants 179/126/22554(derived)/1281 correct; lichen/tests/schc host CTest passes (0.48s). Previous agent's ASan/UBSan bounds harness (22,555 atomic rejection, 22,554->126 frags, 1,281 init) recorded in notes. Pinned-Zephyr runtime validation decomposed into child bead (requires EC2 builder, single-attach EBS).
